2601: from κατά and a derivative of the base of βάσις; to cause to go down, i.e. precipitate:--bring (thrust) down.
2602: from καταβάλλω; a deposition, i.e. founding; figuratively, conception:--conceive, foundation.
2603: from κατά and βραβεύω (in its original sense); to award the price against, i.e. (figuratively) to defraud (of salvation):--beguile of reward.
2605: from κατά and the base of ἄγγελος; to proclaim, promulgate:--declare, preach, shew, speak of, teach.
2607: from κατά and γινώσκω; to note against, i.e. find fault with:--blame, condemn.
2608: from κατά and the base of ῥήγνυμι; to rend in pieces, i.e. crack apart:--break.
2609: from κατά and ἄγω; to lead down; specially, to moor a vessel:--bring (down, forth), (bring to) land, touch.
2610: from κατά and ἀγωνίζομαι; to struggle against, i.e. (by implication) to overcome:--subdue.
2611: from κατά and δέω; to tie down, i.e. bandage (a wound):--bind up.
2612: from κατά intensive and δῆλος; manifest:--far more evident.
2613: from κατά and a derivative of δίκη; to adjudge against, i.e. pronounce guilty:--condemn.
2614: from κατά and διώκω; to hunt down, i.e. search for:--follow after.
2615: from κατά and δουλόω; to enslave utterly:--bring into bondage.
2616: from κατά and a derivative of δυνάστης; to exercise dominion against, i.e. oppress:--oppress.
2617: from κατά and αἰσχύνομαι; to shame down, i.e. disgrace or (by implication) put to the blush:--confound, dishonour, (be a-, make a-)shame(-d).
2618: from κατά and καίω; to burn down (to the ground), i.e. consume wholly:--burn (up, utterly).
2619: from κατά and καλύπτω; to cover wholly, i.e. veil:--cover, hide.
2620: from κατά and καυχάομαι; to exult against (i.e. over):--boast (against), glory, rejoice against.
2621: from κατά and κεῖμαι; to lie down, i.e. (by implication) be sick; specially, to recline at a meal:--keep, lie, sit at meat (down).
2622: from κατά and κλάω; to break down, i.e. divide:--break.
2623: from κατά and κλείω; to shut down (in a dungeon), i.e. incarcerate:--shut up.
2624: from κατά and a derivative of a compound of κλῆρος and δίδωμι; to be a giver of lots to each, i.e. (by implication) to apportion an estate:--divide by lot.
2625: from κατά and κλίνω; to recline down, i.e. (specially) to take a place at table:--(make) sit down (at meat).
2626: from κατά and the base of κλύδων; to dash (wash) down, i.e. (by implication) to deluge:--overflow.
2628: from κατά and ἀκολουθέω; to accompany closely:--follow (after).
2629: from κατά and κόπτω; to chop down, i.e. mangle:--cut.
2630: from κατά and a derivative of κρημνός; to precipitate down:--cast down headlong.
2631: from κατακρίνω; an adverse sentence (the verdict):--condemnation.
2632: from κατά and κρίνω; to judge against, i.e. sentence:--condemn, damn.
2634: from κατά and κυριεύω; to lord against, i.e. control, subjugate:--exercise dominion over (lordship), be lord over, overcome.
2635: from κατάλαλος; to be a traducer, i.e. to slander:--speak against (evil of).
2637: from κατά and the base of λαλέω; talkative against, i.e. a slanderer:--backbiter.
2638: from κατά and λαμβάνω; to take eagerly, i.e. seize, possess, etc. (literally or figuratively):--apprehend, attain, come upon, comprehend, find, obtain, perceive, (over-)take.
2639: from κατά and λέγω (in its original meaning); to lay down, i.e. (figuratively) to enrol:--take into the number.
2640: from καταλείπω; a remainder, i.e. (by implication) a few:--remnant.
2641: from κατά and λείπω; to leave down, i.e. behind; by implication, to abandon, have remaining:--forsake, leave, reserve.
2642: from κατά and λιθάζω; to stone down, i.e. to death:--stone.
2643: from καταλλάσσω; exchange (figuratively, adjustment), i.e. restoration to (the divine) favor:--atonement, reconciliation(-ing).
2644: from κατά and ἀλλάσσω; to change mutually, i.e. (figuratively) to compound a difference:--reconcile.
2645: from κατά and λοιποί; left down (behind), i.e remaining (plural the rest):--residue.
2646: from καταλύω; properly, a dissolution (breaking up of a journey), i.e. (by implication) a lodging-place:-- guestchamber, inn.
2647: from κατά and λύω; to loosen down (disintegrate), i.e. (by implication) to demolish (literally or figuratively); specially (compare κατάλυμα) to halt for the night:--destroy, dissolve, be guest, lodge, come to nought, overthrow, throw down.
2648: from κατά and μανθάνω; to learn thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to note carefully:--consider.
2649: from κατά and μαρτυρέω; to testify against:--witness against.
2650: from κατά and μένω; to stay fully, i.e. reside:--abide.
2651: from κατά and accusative case plural feminine of μόνος (with χώρα implied); according to sole places, i.e. (adverbially) separately:--alone.
2652: from κατά (intensive) and ἀνάθεμα; an imprecation:--curse.
2653: from κατά (intensive) and ἀναθεματίζω; to imprecate:--curse.
2654: from κατά and ἀναλίσκω; to consume utterly:--consume.
2655: from κατά and (to be numb); to grow utterly torpid, i.e. (by implication) slothful (figuratively, expensive):--be burdensome (chargeable).
2656: from κατά and νεύω; to nod down (towards), i.e. (by analogy) to make signs to:--beckon.
2657: from κατά and νοιέω; to observe fully:--behold, consider, discover, perceive.
2658: from κατά and a derivative of ἀντί; to meet against, i.e. arrive at (literally or figuratively):--attain, come.
2659: from κατανύσσω; a prickling (sensation, as of the limbs asleep), i.e. (by implication, (perhaps by some confusion with νεύω or even with νύξ)) stupor (lethargy):--slumber.
2660: from κατά and νύσσω; to pierce thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) to agitate violently ("sting to the quick"):--prick.
2661: from κατά and ἀξιόω; to deem entirely deserving:--(ac-)count worthy.
2662: from κατά and πατέω; to trample down; figuratively, to reject with disdain:--trample, tread (down, underfoot).
2663: from καταπαύω; reposing down, i.e. (by Hebraism) abode:--rest.
2664: from κατά and παύω; to settle down, i.e. (literally) to colonize, or (figuratively) to (cause to) desist:--cease, (give) rest(-rain).
2665: from a compound of κατά and a congener of πέτομαι; something spread thoroughly, i.e. (specially) the door screen (to the Most Holy Place) in the Jewish Temple:--vail.
2666: from κατά and πίνω; to drink down, i.e. gulp entire (literally or figuratively):--devour, drown, swallow (up).
2667: from κατά and πίπτω; to fall down:--fall (down).
2668: from κατά and πλέω; to sail down upon a place, i.e. to land at:--arrive.
2669: from κατά and a derivative of πόνος; to labor down, i.e. wear with toil (figuratively, harass):--oppress, vex.
2670: from κατά and a derivative of the same as Πόντος; to plunge down, i.e. submerge:--drown, sink.
2671: from κατά (intensive) and ἀρά; imprecation, execration:--curse(-d, ing).
2672: middle voice from κατάρα; to execrate; by analogy, to doom:--curse.
2673: from κατά and ἀργέω; to be (render) entirely idle (useless), literally or figuratively:--abolish, cease, cumber, deliver, destroy, do away, become (make) of no (none, without) effect, fail, loose, bring (come) to nought, put away (down), vanish away, make void.
2674: from κατά and ἀριθμέω; to reckon among:--number with.
2675: from κατά and a derivative of ἄρτιος; to complete thoroughly, i.e. repair (literally or figuratively) or adjust:--fit, frame, mend, (make) perfect(-ly join together), prepare, restore.
2678: from κατά and σείω; to sway downward, i.e. make a signal:--beckon.
2679: from κατά and σκάπτω; to undermine, i.e. (by implication) destroy:--dig down, ruin.
2680: from κατά and a derivative of σκεῦος; to prepare thoroughly (properly, by external equipment; whereas ἑτοιμάζω refers rather to internal fitness); by implication, to construct, create:--build, make, ordain, prepare.
2681: from κατά and σκηνόω; to camp down, i.e. haunt; figuratively, to remain:--lodge, rest.
2682: from κατασκηνόω; an encamping, i.e. (figuratively) a perch:--nest.
2683: from κατά and a derivative of σκιά; to overshade, i.e. cover:--shadow.
2684: from κατάσκοπος; to be a sentinel, i.e. to inspect insidiously:--spy out.
2685: from κατά (intensive) and σκοπός (in the sense of a watcher); a reconnoiterer:--spy.
2686: middle voice from κατά and σοφίζω; to be crafty against, i.e. circumvent:--deal subtilly with.
2687: from κατά and στέλλω; to put down, i.e. quell:--appease, quiet.
2688: from καθίστημι; properly, a position or condition, i.e. (subjectively) demeanor:--behaviour.
2689: from καταστέλλω; a deposit, i.e. (specially) costume:--apparel.
2690: from κατά and στρέφω; to turn upside down, i.e. upset:--overthrow.
2691: from κατά and στρηνιάω; to become voluptuous against:--begin to wax wanton against.
2692: from καταστρέφω; an overturn ("catastrophe"), i.e. demolition; figuratively, apostasy:--overthrow, subverting.
2693: from κατά and στρώννυμι; to strew down, i.e. (by implication) to prostrate (slay):--overthrow.
2694: from κατά and σύρω; to drag down, i.e. arrest judicially:--hale.
2695: from κατά and σφάζω; to kill down, i.e. slaughter:--slay.
2696: from κατά and σφραγίζω; to seal closely:--seal.
2697: from κατέχω; a holding down, i.e. occupancy:--possession.
2698: from κατά and τίθημι; to place down, i.e. deposit (literally or figuratively):--do, lay, shew.
2699: from a compound of κατά and (to cut); a cutting down (off), i.e. mutilation (ironically):--concision. Compare ἀποκόπτω.
